# `passportsim audio_capture`

Capture the guest's audio output as a WAV artifact with its fundamental and peak.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `audio` |
| MCP tool | `passport_audio_capture` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/audio_capture` |
| Scenario step | `audio.capture` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `advances_time`, `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim audio_capture [--channel <CHANNEL>] [--cursor <CURSOR>] [--duration-ms <DURATION_MS>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--mode <MODE>] [--save-as <SAVE_AS>] [--wav] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `--channel <CHANNEL>` | `integer` | no | Slot to analyze (0). |
| `cursor` | `--cursor <CURSOR>` | `integer` | no | Sample cursor to read from, without running. |
| `duration_ms` | `--duration-ms <DURATION_MS>` | `integer` | no | Virtual ms to run and capture (1000). |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `mode` | `--mode <MODE>` | `"digital"` \| `"analog"` | no | Playback mode (digital). |
| `save_as` | `--save-as <SAVE_AS>` | `string` | no | Artifact label. |
| `wav` | `--wav` | `boolean` | no | Write a WAV (true when the host can). |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/audio_capture.input.json`](../schema/commands/audio_capture.input.json).

## Examples

### Run 1 s and measure the playback without writing a file

```sh
passportsim audio_capture --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "duration_ms": 1000,
  "wav": false
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "duration_ms": 1000,
  "wav": false
}
'@ | passportsim audio_capture --json -
```

### Analyze what is already in the ring, without a file

```sh
passportsim audio_capture --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "cursor": 0,
  "wav": false
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "cursor": 0,
  "wav": false
}
'@ | passportsim audio_capture --json -
```
